==Quest information==

===Requirements===
* Must not have [[You're a Mean One, Mr. Grenth]] in your [[Quest Log]].

===Objectives===
* Speak to the [[Rift Warden]] when you are ready to defend [[the Underworld]].
* Destroy all followers of [[Dwayna]] who attempt to breach the Underworld. They must not reclaim the stolen presents.
* See Rift Warden for your reward. 
* *BONUS*: Survive for as long as possible. Protect the stolen presents.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 5 [[Wintersday Gift]]s

==Walkthrough==
During this quest, players will be under the effects of [[Yuletide]] and have the Yuletide [[skill bar]] with [[Yellow Snow]] instead of [[Avalanche (skill)|Avalanche]].

The mission is rather simple. Stand beside the gifts and defeat the snowmen as they [[spawn]] one by one, while making sure they don't claim the presents. Use [[Hidden Rock]] and [[Yellow Snow]] while waiting for the next snowman to spawn, so you can avoid activating those skills while being attacked and inflict Disease, Daze and cause knockdown with your next [[Snowball]]. After about 10 minutes have passed, a last snowman called [[Freezie]] will spawn. Its defeat marks the end of the quest. If you're having problems, simply put a pillar between you and the Freezie — you'll be able to take your time regenerating.

===Bonus===
The bonus is acquired by talking to the Avatar of Grenth after finishing the quest. It is best to wait until you have full health and all of your skills recharged before acquiring the bonus. It consists of 6 waves of 6 snowmen each, spawning one at a time. Snowmen on each wave spawn faster than the previous one and waves are triggered after killing the last snowmen to appear in the previous wave, so it may be wise to hold a bit on killing him until the player is ready for the next wave. Players are rewarded 1 [[Candy Cane Shard]] after each wave is defeated.

==Notes==
* Similar to [[You're a Mean One, Mr. Grenth]], the [[foe]]s in this quest can randomly [[drop]] a [[Glob of Frozen Ectoplasm]] or [[Wintersday Gift]], but not a [[Candy Cane Shard]], [[Eggnog]], [[Frosty Tonic]], [[Fruitcake]], [[Mischievous Tonic]] nor [[Snowman Summoner]].
* Same as with the mission, the bonus will fail if the snowmen take possession of the gifts.
* Failing causes you to die; however, if you die, the death will not affect the progress of the [[Survivor]] title.
* A ''"MISSION FAILED: Grenth is not pleased"'' message appears if the mission was failed and  ''"BONUS FAILED: Grenth is not impressed"'' appears if the bonus was failed.
* This quest uses the whole map of [[the Underworld]].
{{bug|The [[Quest Log]] displays ''"Rift Warden ([[The Underworld]])"'', even though this quest is not acquired in The Underworld.}}

==Trivia==
*This quest was introduced in [[Wintersday 2006]].
*Prior to [[Wintersday 2010]], this quest awarded 5 [[Candy Cane Shard]]s instead of Wintersday Gifts.
